facts.fact: The CNDP published five deliberations dated 28 November 2025 setting model declaration and authorisation forms for cookies, newsletters, patient follow-up, healthcare video surveillance and workplace access control, with no decision on a named controller.

The CNDP, Morocco's national commission for the control of personal data protection, validated five new deliberations (D-939 to D-943 of 2025) on 28 November 2025, showing it acting as the supervisory body.
